decision: Approve decorative-index for ProjectCard index: a decorative editorial identifier, not collection position or selection state.

evidence.channel: Owner decision in odd/tasks/web-catalog.md L18 and docs/components/web-catalog/v0.1/layer-c-plan-approvals.md
evidence.interpretation: Scoped human naming approval recorded by the parent; not native review authority.

convention.name: index
convention.meaning: Decorative editorial identifier for a content card, not a collection position or selection state.
convention.whenToUse: A content card renders a supplied editorial identifier as decoration outside its accessible name.
convention.avoid: Collection offsets, selected indexes, ordering controls, or meaningful identifiers that assistive technology must announce.
